Author: Zinochron
Name: BeastMastr
Punchline: Know your beasts and read the board at a glance.
Description:
Quality of life for Beastmaster.

Shows what each beast's actions actually do right on the Master's Bestiary, and dims it to the beasts you are looking for. Fills a levelling team with one press, calls the last fight's familiars when a fight asks for them, picks the most hurt at shops and campsites, remembers your Crucible mode, and briefs the next Crucible of the Unbroken room in a window of its own.

Experimental: /beastmastr run plays a Crucible board on its own: walking, picking rooms, shops, campsites, treasure and the fights, dodging the mechanics it knows. Needs vnavmesh. Moving, jumping, targeting or using an action yourself pauses it.

Opens with /beastmastr.
